en.rules.title: Rules
en.rules.playing_cards.body:
• You may play 1 to 5 cards per judgment.
• You may refresh up to 3 times per battle, replacing 1 to 5 selected cards each time.
• Refreshed cards enter the discard pile and the same number of replacements are drawn from the draw pile.
• If the draw pile cannot provide enough cards, the discard pile is shuffled into a new draw pile.
en.rules.hand.high_card:
Definition: When no other poker hand is formed, the highest selected card scores.
Example: A, J, 8, 5, 2
Scoring Cards: A
Multiplier: ×1.00
en.rules.hand.pair:
Definition: Two cards of the same rank.
Example: Q, Q, 9, 6, 3
Scoring Cards: Q, Q
Multiplier: ×1.25
en.rules.hand.two_pair:
Definition: Two different pairs.
Example: K, K, 7, 7, 3
Scoring Cards: K, K, 7, 7
Multiplier: ×1.50
en.rules.hand.three_of_a_kind:
Definition: Three cards of the same rank.
Example: J, J, J, 8, 4
Scoring Cards: J, J, J
Multiplier: ×1.75
en.rules.hand.straight:
Definition: Five consecutive ranks; suits do not need to match.
Example: 9, 10, J, Q, K
Scoring Cards: All five cards
Multiplier: ×2.00
en.rules.hand.flush:
Definition: Five cards of the same suit; ranks do not need to be consecutive.
Example: Five Spades of different ranks
Scoring Cards: All five cards
Multiplier: ×2.25
en.rules.hand.full_house:
Definition: Three cards of one rank and two cards of another rank.
Example: 10, 10, 10, 6, 6
Scoring Cards: All five cards
Multiplier: ×2.50
en.rules.hand.four_of_a_kind:
Definition: Four cards of the same rank.
Example: 8, 8, 8, 8, K
Scoring Cards: Four 8s
Multiplier: ×2.75
en.rules.hand.straight_flush:
Definition: Five consecutive cards of the same suit.
Example: 9, 10, J, Q, K of Hearts
Scoring Cards: All five cards
Multiplier: ×3.00
en.rules.damage.body:
Base Power = the sum of the ranks of the specified Scoring Cards.
Poker Hand Damage = Base Power × Multiplier.
Selected cards not specified as Scoring Cards do not add to Base Power.

Example: K, K, 7, 7, 3 forms Two Pair.
Base Power: 13 + 13 + 7 + 7 = 40
Multiplier: ×1.50
Poker Hand Damage: 60

The displayed result uses the same rounding rule as the battle preview.

zh_CN.rules.title: 规则详细
zh_CN.rules.playing_cards.body:
• 每次判决可以打出1～5张牌。
• 每场战斗最多刷新3次，每次可以刷新选中的1～5张牌。
• 被刷新的牌进入弃牌堆，并从牌堆抽取等量的新牌。
• 当牌堆不足以完成抽牌时，将弃牌堆洗入新的牌堆。
zh_CN.rules.hand.high_card:
定义：无法组成其他牌型时，以所选牌中点数最高的一张作为计分牌。
示例：A、J、8、5、2
计分牌：A
倍率：×1.00
zh_CN.rules.hand.pair:
定义：两张点数相同的牌。
示例：Q、Q、9、6、3
计分牌：Q、Q
倍率：×1.25
zh_CN.rules.hand.two_pair:
定义：两组不同点数的对子。
示例：K、K、7、7、3
计分牌：K、K、7、7
倍率：×1.50
zh_CN.rules.hand.three_of_a_kind:
定义：三张点数相同的牌。
示例：J、J、J、8、4
计分牌：J、J、J
倍率：×1.75
zh_CN.rules.hand.straight:
定义：五张点数连续、但不要求相同花色的牌。
示例：9、10、J、Q、K
计分牌：全部五张牌
倍率：×2.00
zh_CN.rules.hand.flush:
定义：五张花色相同、但点数不需要连续的牌。
示例：五张不同点数的黑桃
计分牌：全部五张牌
倍率：×2.25
zh_CN.rules.hand.full_house:
定义：一组三条加一组对子。
示例：10、10、10、6、6
计分牌：全部五张牌
倍率：×2.50
zh_CN.rules.hand.four_of_a_kind:
定义：四张点数相同的牌。
示例：8、8、8、8、K
计分牌：四张8
倍率：×2.75
zh_CN.rules.hand.straight_flush:
定义：五张花色相同且点数连续的牌。
示例：同为红桃的9、10、J、Q、K
计分牌：全部五张牌
倍率：×3.00
zh_CN.rules.damage.body:
基础攻击力 = 指定计分牌的点数总和。
牌型伤害 = 基础攻击力 × 牌型倍率。
未被牌型指定为计分牌的其他选中牌不计入基础攻击力。

示例：K、K、7、7、3组成两对。
基础攻击力：13 + 13 + 7 + 7 = 40
倍率：×1.50
基础牌型伤害：60

显示结果使用与战斗预览相同的取整规则。
